name: MetaMask USD
oneLiner: MetaMask USD is a Bridge-issued (Stripe) dollar stablecoin on M0 protocol, backed by short-dated U.S. T-bills and cash with on-chain Validator attestations.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: MUSD resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: MetaMask USD is an M0-backed extension; extension wrapping routes through M0 extension infrastructure while base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing MUSD depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.
controls.evidence: Official M0 deployments list the Ethereum MinterGateway, and M0 docs describe approved-minter plus validator-gated issuance.

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.
controls.evidence: Official M0 deployments list SwapFacility at 0xB6807116b3B1B321a390594e31ECD6e0076f6278 on Ethereum; SwapFacility docs describe approved-extension wrap/swap routing.

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.
controls.evidence: Official M0 deployments list SwapFacility at 0xB6807116b3B1B321a390594e31ECD6e0076f6278 on Linea; SwapFacility docs describe approved-extension wrap/swap routing.

review.evidence: M0 documentation describes permissioned minter/validator rails used by M0-built stablecoins.

collateral: Cash and short-term U.S. Treasury securities held in bankruptcy-remote custody, issued by Bridge (a Stripe company) using the M0 protocol
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption via Bridge using M0 protocol infrastructure; reserves continuously validated on-chain by independent validators; arbitrage corrects price drift; monthly public attestations

applicabilityBasis.summary: MUSD is a Bridge-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin for MetaMask using M0 infrastructure and 1:1 redemption.

genius.notes: Bridge and MetaMask materials describe MUSD issuance and redemption, but Pharos found no token-specific public GENIUS approval as of review.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for MUSD.
